predecessors.name: Zhou dynasty
predecessors.text: Qi, 'Originally in Yongqiu county, now Qi County, Kaifeng, Henan, per Sima Zhen's commentary'

successors.name: Chu
successors.text: Qi, 'Originally in Yongqiu county, now Qi County, Kaifeng, Henan, per Sima Zhen's commentary'

ledger.x: c. 1046: King Wu enfeoffs a descendant of Yu the Great at Qi. The page says only 'Established: 11th century BCE' and that King Wu died c. 1043; the Muye year used by other pages is a bridge.
445: the state of Qi (Henan) ends in Chu's conquest.

wars.name: Chu conquest of Qi
wars.outcome: Chu destroyed Qi in 445 BC; the page says nothing of the land afterwards.

certainty.note: No Qi boundary is on the page and its location moved; soft throughout.
